description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Geist of Saint Thalia.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Quicksmith Genius triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Quicksmith Genius trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat
